It does not access files, paste in answers or use test labels, and it does not change the fit_predict signature or how the seed is used.
No bugs found. These are valid XGBRegressor parameters, and the rest of the pipeline is unchanged.

The candidate is 0.0044 worse than the incumbent (0.5203 vs 0.5159). That is well within the noise of a single run (sd 0.0070). Recomputing z as (0.5159 - 0.5203) / (0.0070 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/1)) gives about -0.44. This matches the harness value of -0.438 up to rounding, so rejecting the candidate is consistent.
Note: each side has only one run, so this comparison has very little statistical power. This small a change is unlikely to be worth a replicate slot.
